column1: # A SIGNAL USED IN A DECISION, FROZEN AT THE MOMENT THE DECISION WAS TAKEN.
# Append-only and digest-chained: each row's `digest` covers its own ten fields
# plus the previous row's digest, so an edit to a historical value breaks that
# row and every row after it. `record-decision.sh snapshot-verify` checks it.
# TAMPER-EVIDENT, NOT TAMPER-PROOF — see that script's header for exactly what
# that does and does not claim.
# WHY THE VALUE AND NOT A RECIPE. A later evaluation must never recompute a
# historical signal against the current tree: that scores a decision nobody took,
# on information nobody had. So the VALUE is stored, with the commit it was
# frozen at and the derivation that produced it, and reading it consults no tree.
# THE THREE DERIVATIONS, AT derivation_version v1. These are the only three
# signals currently derivable in this repository; the schema admits more and
# nothing here pretends the set is complete.
#   dependency_unlock_count       the number of OTHER candidates in the same
#                                 candidate set whose text names this candidate
#                                 as subsuming or unblocking them, read from
#                                 synonym for in_licence: it means the subject
#                                 owns no entry, which is a different fact.
#   declared_mismatch_proximity   the count of controls carrying
#                                 owning_module is one of the candidate's subject
# WHAT THE FIRST TWELVE ROWS RECORD, AND IT IS NOT FLATTERING TO THE SIGNALS.
# The selected candidate scored ZERO on dependency_unlock_count while a candidate
# that scored 1 was not selected. The selection was the operator's ruling, and it
# outranked the only ordering signal that existed. That is recorded rather than
# smoothed over: the point of freezing signals is to be able to ask later whether
# the signals were worth having, and a store that only ever agrees with the choice
# THE FOUR DERIVATIONS ADDED AT derivation_version v2, FOR DECISION-0010. The v1
# set could not be reused wholesale: `dependency_unlock_count`'s v1 derivation
# reads current_state.md's "Next (candidates)" block, and that block does not
# exist at `ce71122`. It is therefore NOT frozen for DECISION-0010, and S1 prints
# it as MISSING rather than as 0 — an absent derivation is not a measurement of
# zero, which is this store's founding rule one level up.
#   candidate_write_surface       the `;`-separated set of objects the candidate
#                                 would modify, each either a whole path or
#                                 residue item and from the address list in
#                                 repository_commit. IT IS A SCREENING INPUT, NOT
#                                 A RANKING SIGNAL: it feeds S1's self-amendment
#                                 guard and contributes to no ordering.
#   residue_items_closed          the number of LETTERED items in
#                                 discharges, counted from that file at
#                                 evidence_refs name the exact letters, so the
#                                 count is auditable rather than asserted.
#   residue_ruling_satisfied      1 if a standing ruling in residue.md or
#                                 active_packet.md names this work as NEXT or as
#                                 endorsed to proceed; 0 if the tree records it
#                                 unevidenced. It is a BINARY reading of
#                                 recorded rulings, not a judgement of merit.
#   census_growth_controls        the number of NEW control_registry.txt entries
#                                 the candidate would add. Same name and same
#                                 direction as v1's use in DECISION-0008/0009,
#                                 so the three are comparable. FORECAST, NOT
#                                 MEASUREMENT — nobody has built these packets,
